title: The Hidden Phone Setting Tracking Your Exact Location 24/7

vo.en: You need to turn off this setting.

visual.description: Close-up shot of a man's hands tapping quickly on a glowing smartphone screen inside a dark room.

vo.en: Even when your Wi-Fi is turned off, your smartphone secretly broadcasts scanning signals into the air every few seconds.

visual.description: Panning shot of high-tech data server racks with flashing green and blue LED lights in a futuristic facility.

vo.en: Retail stores and public venues capture these invisible signals to track your exact physical path through every store aisle.

visual.description: Tracking shot following a man walking through a modern shopping mall concourse with polished floors.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part: commercial data brokers buy this location history to map out your entire daily routine.

visual.description: Over-the-shoulder shot of a man reviewing glowing digital map analytics on dual computer monitors.

vo.en: To stop this tracking, open your phone settings, search for Wi-Fi Scanning, and turn off background location accuracy immediately.

visual.description: Macro shot of a man's thumb toggling off a digital slider switch on a modern smartphone display.

vo.en: Protect your privacy today. Subscribe for tomorrow's hidden tech hacks, and comment DONE if you flipped the switch... which is exactly why
